title: What I Carry
caption:
What I Carry

For years, my work has kept me in motion,
a suitcase always in one hand.
Slowly, my belongings have grown fewer,
and I have found a quiet happiness in that.

Owning less is not about having less.
It is about choosing.
Before anything comes home with me, I ask:
Is this truly mine? Does it belong in my life?
And when something no longer fits,
I let it go, without hesitation.

To wear, and to live with, only what I need —
this is when I feel most like myself,
with room left for what I want to focus on.

Perhaps that is why I do this work:
to choose, for each person, only what they need,
and nothing more.
The joy of having just enough
is something I hope to share, wherever I go.
